en.topic_title: Hong Kong Housing Society raises public housing rent by 2.85%
en.topic_summary:
Rent for public housing under the Hong Kong Housing Society (HKHS) will increase by 2.85 per cent from October. 



Prosperous Garden in Yau Ma Tei. Photo: Hong Kong Housing Society.



The HKHS said in a statement on Tuesday that the new rent will be effective from October 1 this year to September 30, 2028.



For rental units falling into Group A, which caters to low-income families, the average monthly rent increase per household is about HK$73.
